d:
In this video, I travel to Libya for the very first time, a country that the Indian government restricted its citizens from visiting for years.
I land in Tripoli, the capital of Libya, to experience the country for myself and see what life here is really like. From the streets of Tripoli and its people to Libya’s complicated recent history, I explore the side of the country that most people never get to see.
I also dive into the legacy of Muammar Gaddafi, who ruled Libya for more than four decades, and discover how much of his influence and memory still remains in the country today.
